preflight_amendments.diagnosis: A shared scalar bias on all 16 spectral scores cancels exactly in softmax. Its Full CE gradient is mathematically zero and was exactly zero in G1 Fold 5. Remove that unidentifiable parameter and update the independent optional-bias reconstruction. Fully rerun preflight.

audit_amendment.scope: independent audit and post-terminal transition witness
audit_amendment.change: Require an independently derived IEEE float32 rounding certificate for a budgeted zero addend. Use two independently loaded terminal witnesses and one subsequent independent audit.

projection.finding: Relative cosine loses precision for a nearly zero projected gradient. Audit in original norm units using dimension-based roundoff for dot products and squared norms.
